passage: Passage 1: It was a summer afternoon. Gopi was sitting in the veranda, reading a book. Suddenly, he heard something rustling past and falling with a thud in the garden. He thought it could be a mango falling from the tree. Immediately, Gopi put his book aside, got up, and ran into the garden. He searched in between the thick grass near the garden fence, but found nothing. He looked among the bushes and then his eyes fell on a heap of dry leaves. There was a white ball on the heap. Gopi reached out and took the ball in his hands. It was a hockey ball.

questions.question: Why did Gopi run into the garden?
questions.optionA: He wanted to play with his friends
questions.optionB: He wanted to find out what had fallen in the garden
questions.optionC: He wanted to water the plants
questions.optionD: He wanted to read his book there
questions.explanation: ଗୋପୀ ବଗିଚାରେ କିଛି ଜିନିଷ ଶବ୍ଦ କରି ପଡ଼ିବାର ଶୁଣିଥିଲା। ତେଣୁ କ’ଣ ପଡ଼ିଲା ଜାଣିବା ପାଇଁ ସେ ବହିଟିକୁ ରଖି ବଗିଚାକୁ ଦୌଡ଼ିଗଲା। ତେଣୁ B ସଠିକ୍ ଉତ୍ତର।

questions.question: What did Gopi first think had fallen from the tree?
questions.explanation: ଗୋପୀ ଶବ୍ଦ ଶୁଣି ପ୍ରଥମେ ଭାବିଥିଲା ଯେ ଗଛରୁ ହୁଏତ ଗୋଟିଏ ଆମ୍ବ ପଡ଼ିଛି। ତେଣୁ C ସଠିକ୍ ଉତ୍ତର।

questions.question: Where did Gopi finally find the ball?
questions.optionD: On a heap of dry leaves
questions.explanation: ଗୋପୀ ପ୍ରଥମେ ଘନ ଘାସ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଓ ପରେ ବୁଦା ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଖୋଜିଥିଲା। ଶେଷରେ ଶୁଖିଲା ପତ୍ରର ଗଦା ଉପରେ ଧଳା ବଲ୍‌ଟିକୁ ଦେଖିଲା। ତେଣୁ D ସଠିକ୍।

questions.question: Why was Gopi unsure about what had fallen in the garden?
questions.optionA: He had not heard any sound
questions.optionB: He had only heard a sound and had not seen the object
questions.optionC: He was playing with a ball
questions.optionD: His friends had told him what it was
questions.explanation: ଗୋପୀ କେବଳ କିଛି ପଡ଼ିବାର ଶବ୍ଦ ଶୁଣିଥିଲା, କିନ୍ତୁ କ’ଣ ପଡ଼ିଲା ତାହା ନିଜ ଆଖିରେ ଦେଖିନଥିଲା। ସେଥିପାଇଁ ସେ ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ନଥିଲା। ତେଣୁ B ସଠିକ୍।

questions.question: Which sequence correctly describes Gopi's actions?
questions.optionA: He found the ball, read a book, and went inside
questions.optionB: He heard a sound, ran to the garden, searched, and found the ball
questions.optionC: He went to the playground, played hockey, and returned home
questions.optionD: He drank water, found the ball, and went to sleep
questions.explanation: ପ୍ରଥମେ ଗୋପୀ ଶବ୍ଦ ଶୁଣିଲା, ପରେ ବଗିଚାକୁ ଦୌଡ଼ିଗଲା, ବିଭିନ୍ନ ସ୍ଥାନରେ ଖୋଜିଲା ଏବଂ ଶେଷରେ ବଲ୍‌ଟି ପାଇଲା। ତେଣୁ B ସଠିକ୍।

passage: Passage 2: Gopi wondered whose ball it could be. He looked around and looked outside the gate, but could see no one. Just then he heard his mother calling, “Gopi! What are you doing out in the garden? It’s very hot. Come inside.” Gopi went inside, drank a glass of water, and said to himself, “I can’t keep this ball for myself. I will ask others.” In the evening, Gopi went to the nearby playground where all his friends regularly gathered to play hockey every day. He asked them whether any of them had lost a ball recently.

questions.question: Why did Gopi decide not to keep the ball for himself?
questions.optionB: He thought the ball might belong to someone else
questions.optionC: His mother asked him to throw it away
questions.explanation: ଗୋପୀ ଭାବିଲା ଯେ ବଲ୍‌ଟି ଅନ୍ୟ କାହାର ହୋଇପାରେ। ସେଥିପାଇଁ ନିଜ ପାଖରେ ରଖିବା ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତେ ଏହାର ମାଲିକଙ୍କୁ ଖୋଜିବାକୁ ଚାହିଁଲା। ତେଣୁ B ସଠିକ୍।

questions.question: Why did Gopi go to the playground in the evening?
questions.optionC: To ask his friends about the lost ball
questions.optionD: To buy a new hockey stick
questions.explanation: ସନ୍ଧ୍ୟାବେଳେ ଗୋପୀ ନିକଟସ୍ଥ ଖେଳ ପଡ଼ିଆକୁ ଯାଇ ନିଜ ସାଙ୍ଗମାନଙ୍କୁ କେହି ବଲ୍‌ ହରାଇଛନ୍ତି କି ନାହିଁ ପଚାରିଥିଲା। ତେଣୁ C ସଠିକ୍।

questions.question: What does Gopi's decision about the ball tell us about his character?
questions.optionD: He was afraid of playing hockey
questions.explanation: ଗୋପୀ ବଲ୍‌ଟି ପାଇଥିଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ନିଜ ପାଖରେ ରଖିନଥିଲା। ଏହାର ମାଲିକଙ୍କୁ ଖୋଜିବାକୁ ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରିଥିଲା। ଏଥିରୁ ତାହାର ସଚ୍ଚୋଟତା ଓ ଦାୟିତ୍ୱବୋଧ ପ୍ରକାଶ ପାଏ। ତେଣୁ C ସଠିକ୍।

questions.question: What did Gopi do before going to the playground?
questions.optionB: He drank a glass of water
questions.explanation: ଗୋପୀର ମାଆ ତାକୁ ଘରକୁ ଡାକିବା ପରେ ସେ ଘରକୁ ଯାଇ ଗୋଟିଏ ଗ୍ଲାସ ପାଣି ପିଇଥିଲା। ତା’ପରେ ସନ୍ଧ୍ୟାରେ ପଡ଼ିଆକୁ ଯାଇଥିଲା। ତେଣୁ B ସଠିକ୍।

questions.question: What is the closest meaning of 'recently' in the passage?
questions.explanation: ‘Recently’ ଶବ୍ଦର ଅର୍ଥ ହେଉଛି ‘ଅଳ୍ପ ସମୟ ପୂର୍ବରୁ’ ବା ‘ବେଶି ଦିନ ହୋଇନଥିବା ସମୟରେ’। ତେଣୁ B ସଠିକ୍।

passage: Passage 3: Manoj said, “I lost a ball four months ago.” Gopi said, “So, the ball that I found can’t be yours.” Ramani said, “The ball is mine.” Gopi asked, “How do you know? What colour is it?” Ramani replied, “Show me the ball and I will tell you.” Another friend, Deepak, said that his father had bought him a brand-new football the day before. Gopi showed the ball to Ramani. Ramani smiled and said that it was not his ball. Everyone laughed.

questions.question: Why did Gopi reject Manoj's claim?
questions.optionB: Manoj had lost his ball four months ago
questions.optionC: Manoj said the ball was a football
questions.optionD: Manoj had never owned a ball
questions.explanation: ମନୋଜ କହିଥିଲା ଯେ ସେ ଚାରି ମାସ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ବଲ୍‌ଟି ହରାଇଥିଲା। କିନ୍ତୁ ଗୋପୀ ନିକଟରେ ଏହି ବଲ୍‌ଟି ପାଇଥିଲା। ତେଣୁ ଗୋପୀ ଭାବିଲା ଯେ ଏହି ବଲ୍‌ଟି ମନୋଜର ହୋଇପାରିବ ନାହିଁ। ତେଣୁ B ସଠିକ୍।

questions.question: What did Ramani say when Gopi asked whose ball it was?
questions.explanation: ଗୋପୀ ବଲ୍‌ଟି କାହାର ବୋଲି ପଚାରିବାରୁ ରମଣୀ କହିଥିଲା, ‘The ball is mine.’ ଅର୍ଥାତ୍ ବଲ୍‌ଟି ତାହାର ବୋଲି ଦାବି କରିଥିଲା। ତେଣୁ C ସଠିକ୍।

questions.question: Why did Gopi ask Ramani about the colour of the ball?
questions.optionA: To identify whether the ball belonged to her
questions.explanation: ରମଣୀ ବଲ୍‌ଟି ନିଜର ବୋଲି ଦାବି କରିଥିଲା। ଗୋପୀ ତାହାର ଦାବି ସତ କି ନାହିଁ ଜାଣିବା ପାଇଁ ବଲ୍‌ର ରଙ୍ଗ କ’ଣ ବୋଲି ପଚାରିଥିଲା। ତେଣୁ A ସଠିକ୍।

questions.question: What was unusual about Deepak's statement?
questions.optionA: He had lost a hockey ball four months earlier
questions.optionB: His father had bought him a brand-new football the day before
questions.optionC: He had found a white hockey ball
questions.optionD: He did not know how to play football
questions.explanation: ଦୀପକ କହିଥିଲା ଯେ ତାଙ୍କ ବାପା ତାକୁ ଗତକାଲି ଗୋଟିଏ ନୂଆ football କିଣିଦେଇଥିଲେ। ଏହି କଥା ଗୋପୀ ପାଇଥିବା hockey ball ସହିତ ମେଳ ଖାଉନଥିଲା। ତେଣୁ B ସଠିକ୍।

questions.question: Why did everyone laugh at the end of the passage?
questions.optionA: Ramani discovered that the ball was not hers
questions.explanation: ରମଣୀ ପ୍ରଥମେ ବଲ୍‌ଟି ନିଜର ବୋଲି କହିଥିଲା। କିନ୍ତୁ ବଲ୍‌ଟି ଦେଖିବା ପରେ ସେ ଏହା ନିଜର ନୁହେଁ ବୋଲି ବୁଝିଲା। ଏହି ଘଟଣାରେ ସମସ୍ତେ ହସିଥିଲେ। ତେଣୁ A ସଠିକ୍।

passage: Passage 4: Gopi took out the ball from his pocket. Manoj took it away from Gopi and threw it to Deepak. Seeing this, Gopi said at the top of his voice, “Stop! I say, stop! Let’s play before it gets dark.” Manoj was very happy as he liked to be a goalkeeper. Gopi stood at the centre of the field holding the hockey stick. He passed the ball to Deepak, who threw the ball towards Ramani. Ramani hit the ball with the stick towards Jay.

questions.question: What did the children decide to do with the ball after the claims were settled?
questions.explanation: ବଲ୍‌ଟି କାହାର ତାହା ନିର୍ଣ୍ଣୟ ହୋଇନଥିବା ପରେ ଗୋପୀ ସନ୍ଧ୍ୟା ହେବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଖେଳିବାକୁ କହିଥିଲା। ତା’ପରେ ସେମାନେ hockey ଖେଳିବା ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିଥିଲେ। ତେଣୁ C ସଠିକ୍।

questions.question: Why was Manoj happy?
questions.optionA: He had found his lost ball
questions.optionB: He liked to be a goalkeeper
questions.explanation: ମନୋଜ goalkeeper ହେବାକୁ ପସନ୍ଦ କରୁଥିଲା। ଖେଳ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହେବାରୁ ସେ ଖୁସି ହୋଇଥିଲା। ତେଣୁ B ସଠିକ୍।

questions.question: Where was Gopi positioned while playing?
questions.optionC: At the centre of the field
questions.explanation: ଖେଳିବା ସମୟରେ ଗୋପୀ ହକି ଷ୍ଟିକ୍ ଧରି ପଡ଼ିଆର ମଝିରେ ଠିଆ ହୋଇଥିଲା। ତେଣୁ C ସଠିକ୍।

questions.question: Who received the ball after Gopi passed it?
questions.explanation: ଗୋପୀ ବଲ୍‌ଟିକୁ ଦୀପକଙ୍କ ପାଖକୁ ପାସ୍ କରିଥିଲା। ତା’ପରେ ଦୀପକ ବଲ୍‌ଟିକୁ ରମଣୀଙ୍କ ଆଡ଼କୁ ପଠାଇଥିଲା। ତେଣୁ B ସଠିକ୍।

questions.question: Which sequence of players handled the ball is correct?
questions.explanation: ପାଠ୍ୟ ଅନୁସାରେ ଗୋପୀ ବଲ୍‌ଟିକୁ ଦୀପକଙ୍କୁ ପାସ୍ କରିଥିଲା, ଦୀପକ ରମଣୀଙ୍କ ଆଡ଼କୁ ପଠାଇଥିଲା ଏବଂ ରମଣୀ ଜୟଙ୍କ ଆଡ଼କୁ ବଲ୍‌ଟିକୁ ମାରିଥିଲା। ତେଣୁ A ସଠିକ୍।

passage: Passage 5: Jay tightened his wrist around the stick with the flat side touching the ball. He hit the ball so hard that it went past the playground gate and fell into the basket of a passing scooter. The scooterist, who was unaware of what had happened, drove past. By the time the children ran to the gate, the scooter was gone... and so was the ball. They looked at each other and burst into laughter.

questions.question: Why did the ball disappear from the children's sight?
questions.optionB: The ball went into the basket of a passing scooter
questions.optionD: Gopi put it in his pocket
questions.explanation: ଜୟ ବଲ୍‌ଟିକୁ ଏତେ ଜୋରରେ ମାରିଥିଲା ଯେ ଏହା ପଡ଼ିଆର ଗେଟ୍ ପାର ହୋଇ ଯାଉଥିବା ଗୋଟିଏ scooterର basket ଭିତରେ ପଡ଼ିଗଲା। scooterଟି ଚାଲିଯିବା ସହିତ ବଲ୍‌ଟି ମଧ୍ୟ ଚାଲିଗଲା। ତେଣୁ B ସଠିକ୍।

questions.question: Why was the scooterist unaware of what had happened?
questions.optionC: He did not know that the ball had fallen into his scooter basket
questions.explanation: ବଲ୍‌ଟି scooterର basket ଭିତରେ ପଡ଼ିଥିବା କଥା scooter ଚାଳକ ଜାଣିନଥିଲେ। ସେଥିପାଇଁ ସେ କିଛି ନଜାଣି scooter ଚଳାଇ ଚାଲିଗଲେ। ତେଣୁ C ସଠିକ୍।

questions.question: What happened before the children reached the playground gate?
questions.optionB: The scooter had already driven away
questions.explanation: ପିଲାମାନେ ଦୌଡ଼ି ଗେଟ୍ ପାଖରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିବା ବେଳକୁ scooterଟି ସେଠାରୁ ଚାଲିଯାଇଥିଲା। ବଲ୍‌ଟି ମଧ୍ୟ scooter ସହିତ ଚାଲିଯାଇଥିଲା। ତେଣୁ B ସଠିକ୍।

questions.question: What does 'burst into laughter' mean?
questions.explanation: ‘Burst into laughter’ର ଅର୍ଥ ହେଉଛି ହଠାତ୍ ଜୋରରେ ହସିବା ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିବା। ତେଣୁ A ସଠିକ୍।

questions.question: Why did the children laugh even though the ball was gone?
questions.optionD: They wanted to leave the playground
questions.explanation: ବଲ୍‌ଟି ହଠାତ୍ ଗୋଟିଏ ଚାଲୁଥିବା scooterର basketରେ ପଡ଼ିଯାଇଥିଲା ଏବଂ scooterଟି ବଲ୍‌କୁ ନେଇ ଚାଲିଯାଇଥିଲା। ଏହି ଅପ୍ରତ୍ୟାଶିତ ଓ ମଜାଳିଆ ଘଟଣା ଦେଖି ପିଲାମାନେ ହସିଥିଲେ। ତେଣୁ A ସଠିକ୍।

question: Which word in the chapter means 'the sound of light dry things moving together'?
explanation: ‘Rustling’ ଶବ୍ଦର ଅର୍ଥ ହେଉଛି ହାଲୁକା ଶୁଖିଲା ଜିନିଷଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଏକାଠି ହଲଚଲ କଲେ ହେଉଥିବା ଶବ୍ଦ। ତେଣୁ B ସଠିକ୍।

question: Choose the correct word to complete the sentence: Gopi worked hard for his English Test ______ he wanted to get good marks.
explanation: ବାକ୍ୟର ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଅଂଶରେ ଗୋପୀ କାହିଁକି ପରିଶ୍ରମ କରିଥିଲା ତାହାର କାରଣ ଦିଆଯାଇଛି। କାରଣ ବୁଝାଇବା ପାଇଁ ‘because’ ବ୍ୟବହାର ହୁଏ। ତେଣୁ A ସଠିକ୍।

question: Which word is the adverb in the sentence: 'Gopi immediately got up and ran into the garden.'?
explanation: ‘Immediately’ ଶବ୍ଦଟି ଗୋପୀ କେତେ ଶୀଘ୍ର ଉଠି ବଗିଚାକୁ ଦୌଡ଼ିଗଲା ତାହା ବୁଝାଏ। ଏହା କ୍ରିୟାକୁ ବିଶେଷିତ କରୁଥିବାରୁ ଏହା ଏକ adverb। ତେଣୁ C ସଠିକ୍।

question: Choose the correct contraction for 'could not'.
explanation: ‘Could not’ର ସଠିକ୍ contraction ହେଉଛି ‘couldn’t’। ଏଠାରେ ‘not’ର କିଛି ଅକ୍ଷର ବାଦ ଯାଇ apostrophe ବ୍ୟବହାର ହୋଇଛି। ତେଣୁ A ସଠିକ୍।

question: According to the bio-data given in the chapter, which combination is correct for Dilip Tirkey?
optionA: Football, born in Bhubaneswar, Padma Shri only
